newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar trade closed on Monday, Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar trade closed on Monday, Tuesday.

text.p: Indian sugar markets were closed on Monday and will remain shut on Tuesday too for local religious festivals, dealers said. They reopen on Wednesday.
On Friday, Indian sugar prices weakened as reports of the government increasing the free sale quota for October swept the markets, they said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 25 rupees to 1,295/1,360 rupees per quintal while M-30 fell by 25/29 rupees to 1,331/1,390 rupees in Friday trading.
